label: Scrapegraph Ai
description: Scrape pages, extract JSON, search the web, manage monitors and crawls

operations.name: scrape_url
operations.description: Scrape one URL into selected formats. Format errors remain in the output.

operations.name: extract
operations.description: Extract structured JSON from exactly one URL, HTML or Markdown source.

operations.name: search
operations.description: Search and scrape a bounded number of results.

operations.name: list_history
operations.description: Read one page of this account's request history.

operations.name: get_history
operations.description: Read a single request, including its stored parameters and result.

operations.name: create_monitor
operations.description: Create a recurring scrape. The provider bills scheduled runs.

operations.name: list_monitors
operations.description: List this account's monitors (the API returns an unpaginated array).

operations.name: get_monitor
operations.description: Read one monitor and its schedule configuration.

operations.name: update_monitor
operations.description: Change a monitor name, interval, output formats or notification destination.

operations.name: delete_monitor
operations.description: Delete a monitor and stop its future scheduled runs.

operations.name: get_monitor_activity
operations.description: Read one page of monitor ticks; pass nextCursor to the next call.

operations.name: pause_monitor
operations.description: Pause future monitor ticks.

operations.name: resume_monitor
operations.description: Resume a paused monitor's scheduled ticks.

operations.name: start_crawl
operations.description: Start a bounded asynchronous crawl; poll get_crawl for progress.

operations.name: get_crawl
operations.description: Read crawl status and the provider's current page summary.

operations.name: delete_crawl
operations.description: Delete the selected crawl.

operations.name: list_crawl_pages
operations.description: Read one page of crawl results using the provider's numeric cursor.

operations.name: stop_crawl
operations.description: Request a running crawl to stop; this is an acknowledgement.

operations.name: resume_crawl
operations.description: Request a paused crawl to resume; poll get_crawl for progress.

operations.name: get_credits
operations.description: Read remaining and used credits and crawl/monitor job limits.

operations.name: get_account
operations.description: Validate the key and read its account email.
